Predávajúci môže z ceny ubrať pár tisíc eur, no drahšia hypotéka ukrojí z možností kupujúceho oveľa viac. Kto dnes na vlastné bývanie tesne dosiahne, o niekoľko mesiacov už nemusí...pokračovanie Plynové zásobníky sú poloprázdne. Väčším rizikom než nedostatok je cena Veľká kapacita zásobníkov chráni Slovensko pred okamžitým výpadkom. Pred drahým plynom však priemysel neochráni ani štátny rozpočet Odborníčka: Dve firmy, nižšia daň? Kontrola ich môže zdaniť ako jednu Keď niekto rozdelí podnikanie len s cieľom ušetriť na daniach, správca dane mu ju dorubí Jedna faktúra sa mení na dvanásť. Prenajímateľom pribudne povinnosť Pravidelné platby nájomného môžu zakryť chýbajúci doklad. Firmy si musia preveriť fakturáciu aj pri zmluvách, ktoré uzatvorili pred rokmi Štefan Rosina mladší ozdravuje firmy a mení Matador na investičný holding Z priemyselnej skupiny buduje holding, ktorý má byť menej závislý od automotivu. Kým líder trhu vymazal vysokú stratu, zvyšku odvetvia prudko klesol zisk Po smrti už nič nepodpíšete. Kryonika chyby neodpúšťa Aj státisíce eur môžu byť zbytočné, ak po smrti zlyhá jediný článok zmluvného a logistického reťazca

80100.subject: MetaMask Pulls Its Validators Out of Lido
80100.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[MetaMask Staking](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/metamask-staking-exits-lido-validators-after-infrastructure-compromise)**[ began exiting its Lido validators after an infrastructure compromise, with up to 45 days to re-enter](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/metamask-staking-exits-lido-validators-after-infrastructure-compromise)

* **[Hyperliquid](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/onchain-perps-close-execution-gap-with-centralized-exchanges)**[ matched centralized depth on four of five crypto assets and cost less all-in, Castle Labs found](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/onchain-perps-close-execution-gap-with-centralized-exchanges)

* **[World Liberty](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/world-liberty-launches-wlfi-staking-plans-1-25m-usd1-pool)**[ opened WLFI staking with a $1.25M USD1 pool, a 180-day lock and a voting requirement](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/world-liberty-launches-wlfi-staking-plans-1-25m-usd1-pool)

* **[EIP-8363's authors](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/authors-pull-ethereum-staking-reward-burn-from-hegot)**[ pulled the Ethereum staking reward burn out of the Hegotá upgrade](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/authors-pull-ethereum-staking-reward-burn-from-hegot)

* **[Judge Rochon](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/judge-dismisses-libra-m3m3-class-action-with-prejudice)**[ dismissed the LIBRA and M3M3 class action with prejudice, finding six months too short for RICO](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/judge-dismisses-libra-m3m3-class-action-with-prejudice)

Exiting an Ethereum validator and getting the ETH back are separate events. Lido put the distance between them at up to 45 days: the exit, then the sweep to a withdrawal address, then a queue to get back in.

MetaMask Staking [began exiting the validators it operates inside Lido](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/metamask-staking-exits-lido-validators-after-infrastructure-compromise) after an infrastructure compromise, according to Lido's Sept. 30 disclosure. MetaMask said on Oct. 1 that it found no indication wallets or customer funds were affected, and called the exits precautionary. Lido expects the last of them out by Oct. 7, told stETH holders no action is required, and warned of foregone rewards and downtime penalties if validators go offline. Neither company has said how the infrastructure was compromised. Sentora's Morpho vaults [saw sharp outflows](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/sentora-s-morpho-vaults-see-sharp-outflows-amid-metamask-staking-incident) overnight.

It was less than three months ago when Consensys [halted MetaMask releases in July over a North Korea-linked contractor](https://thedefiant.io/news/security/consensys-halted-metamask-releases-over-north-korea-linked-contractor).
